published_prior_art.cite: VariciKatzWeiSattigeriTajer2024Interventional proves local intervention-size conditions and an O(n²) recovery algorithm, but not a full-oracle finite-versus-infinite minimax count threshold.
VariciKatzWeiSattigeriTajer2024Interventional gives a headwise O(n²) CADIM policy; this is a new explicit cover-based upper design for the heterogeneous-mixture oracle model.
VariciKatzWeiSattigeriTajer2024Interventional assumes I-mixture faithfulness but does not provide the proposed uniform positive-binary realization theorem for replicated transcript adversaries.

VariciKatzWeiSattigeriTajer2024Interventional, Conclusion, explicitly leaves constrained-size intervention-count lower bounds as future work; ShanmugamKocaogluDimakisVishwanath2015SmallInterventions is single-DAG.
GreenewaldKatzShanmugamEtAl2019CausalTrees gives a factor-two adaptive policy for one known causal tree, not exact minimax counts for heterogeneous directed-tree mixtures.
VariciKatzWeiSattigeriTajer2024Interventional Theorem 3 supplies a cycle-free local recovery policy and quadratic total count, not an exact adaptive count law.
The cited mixture and single-DAG intervention-design papers provide size bounds or approximation/count guarantees in different models, not these exact full-oracle mixture slices.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Specify the universal frontier Q as an explicit finite optimization or recurrence with its input encoding and evaluation complexity; this would turn “evaluable” into a checkable algorithmic contribution.
Add worked n=3 and n=4 mixture fixtures that compute the exact transcript alternatives, blocker cover, and resulting minimax count from complete oracle answers.
State a direct comparison corollary quantifying when the parent-blocking schedule is strictly below CADIM’s quadratic count, rather than leaving the improvement implicit.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the field-tier universal constrained-size minimax frontier as the kernel; prioritize a legal coexistence construction for the lower packing and a uniform faithful-realization proof.
